purpose: Fetch and preserve public source-controlled TokaMark metadata needed to resolve task IDs, smallest usable public batch/artifact, MAST shot IDs, campaign/time ordering, target/event definition, diagnostic provenance, and timing metadata before shot-level precursor/reachability analysis.
